principles: Do not redirect a source URL until an equivalent or intentionally consolidated target has been reviewed.
Preserve useful historical and search equity; do not blanket-redirect every legacy URL to the homepage.
Keep Flúgos historical/archive intent separate from current B2B experience intent.
HelloÜzlet becomes a migration source for the HIPStudio Business pillar, not a master brand.

Flúgos remains a specialist entry-domain and infrastructure boundary; incomplete Flúgos entry-domain inventory is tracked explicitly but does not silently redefine the hipstudio.hu master-domain release scope.
DNS, HTTP 301/410 rules and Wix retirement require separate production approval.

entrypoints.sourceRole: Flúgos specialist brand and experience entrypoint
entrypoints.archiveException: Historical Flúgos URLs require URL-by-URL archive mapping and must not be blindly redirected to the current sales page.
entrypoints.separateCutoverGate: Complete the Flúgos URL/file inventory and approve its Vercel entry-domain behavior before changing flugos.hu.

masterReleaseGates: current hipstudio.hu sitemap URL inventory is complete and represented in the legacy URL matrix
classify each current hipstudio.hu URL to a semantically equivalent or intentionally consolidated final target
verify every planned target exists in the final production artifact with the intended canonical state
verify no redirect chain, loop, self-redirect or unrelated blanket-home redirect is introduced
approve production redirect activation and keep rollback instructions current
after cutover verify live redirects, canonical/indexability, sitemap/robots and Search Console

hellouzlet.hu: verify the known root target is live before activating the retired-domain redirect
flugos.hu: complete the full Flúgos Wix page/file URL inventory including historical downloads
classify each Flúgos URL as current entry redirect, archive-preserve, preserve-until-mirrored or justified 410
verify historical archive targets preserve historical intent
approve and verify the separate Vercel entry-domain behavior before changing flugos.hu
